title: Japanese: linking writing, speech and rules
description: Move from the character to the word and the phrase, keeping the link between different kinds of practice.

blocks.text: Learning Japanese, a person may keep separate apps for kana, kanji, vocabulary and grammar. The idea sits at the joins: a familiar character has to be recognized inside a word, and the word used in a sentence.

quote.text: I’m using this along with Anki to learn Japanese’s and have been for about 2 months now and it’s a great combination

blocks.text: Link a familiar character to a new phrase

From a phrase you have read, the characters you need open up along with a short explanation of the construction. Then you can write the difficult character and build another phrase with the same word. The app keeps exactly that transition, instead of making you copy the material into several lists again.
One transition instead of one more course

For a first version a limited set of texts and a single difficulty level is enough. A full Japanese course would take a great deal of editorial work. If the existing tools are already linked conveniently, a standalone product here may be unnecessary: integration is more useful.
